title: Read time series and their display options

blocks.content: Practice reading a time series and its display options. Start with "How has this value gone up and down over time?" Read a time series, then compare interpolation, fill opacity, and stacking to see how the display changes what you read.
Use demo dashboards on Grafana Play. Every display option is shown by a finished panel, so you don't need to edit or save anything. The examples demonstrate displays, not real operational limits.
